jobs.name: 鐘守イラ
jobs.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: character turnaround REFERENCE SHEET for the original game "Ash Estuary". One landscape image, approximately 3:2. Opaque plain warm ivory paper background.
Inputs: Image 1 is STYLE B: match its actual delicate irregular pen lines, restrained hatching, pale watercolor and muted coastal palette. Image 2 is the existing IDENTITY AND COSTUME reference for ONE named character. Preserve that exact person's face, age appearance, skin, body proportions, hair, garment layers, materials, repairs and colors. Do not reinterpret their identity from an archetype or copy the reference image's pose.
Layout: EXACTLY THREE FULL-BODY views of the SAME PERSON in three evenly spaced columns: LEFT = strict straight-on FRONT, CENTER = strict 90-degree LEFT PROFILE, RIGHT = straight-on BACK. This is a model/reference turnaround, not three action illustrations. All three are on the same baseline at exactly the same apparent scale and total height. Each head and both feet are inside the frame with generous margins. Orthographic-style observation, no perspective foreshortening, no three-quarter view, no over-the-shoulder face in the back view.
Pose: matching neutral relaxed A-pose in all three views, arms very slightly away from the sides to show clothing, hands relaxed downward, feet set naturally. Neutral expression. Nothing held in the hands. Keep worn belt attachments; set aside handheld props so the clothes can be seen. Do not add a prop pile or accessory inset.
Continuity: closures, hems, pockets, patches and worn belt items stay on the anatomically correct same side as the person turns. Use a plausible simple construction for parts hidden in the existing reference, without adding embroidery, insignia or new equipment. Back of hair must match the existing cut/tied arrangement. One consistent human anatomy and silhouette across all three views.
Rendering: same quiet pen-and-watercolor drawing as the input images, clear material edges, pale overcast modeling, lightly visible paper, no environment or decorative scenic background. No anime, glossy 3D, photorealism, oil paint, heroic poses or bright grading. No panel borders, separators, captions, title, labels, numbers, watermark or readable writing.
World: ordinary coastal labor, no magic glow, ghosts, memory visions, armor, weapons, bodily corrosion or exposed plot secrets.
Character-specific identity and turnaround notes:
Ira: preserve the actual lean woman in image 2 with chin-length dark hair and gray temple strands, long slate-blue upright-collar coat, ivory shirt, moss shoulder cloth, gray-brown trousers and lace-up worn brown boots. Keep the small off-center coat fastening and the ordinary iron keys worn at the belt on the same anatomical side. The moss shoulder cloth falls naturally across the shoulders and upper back. Remove the handheld closed ledger for this sheet; the ledger is not a costume layer. Match the lengths seen in image 2, not a new robe.
